findings: Maldacena 2004.06084v2 section 3/reference [21] explicitly cites the smaller nonperturbative mass result, so that concern is not new.
The source flavor count N is distinct from magnetic degeneracy q; the present matter theory has N=1.
Small g^2 is not itself a uniform large-q bound on the nonspherical collective response.
Angular kernel and maximum-principle arguments support a joint parameter decision, not an interacting physical damping theorem.
